prompt:
You help a busy software engineer (job hunting, runs small open-source game projects) PRIORITISE his inbox. Do not decide what to do with an item; only estimate its priority on two scales:
- urgency 0-100: how soon he must look at it (100 = right now, 0 = can wait weeks)
- importance 0-100: how much it matters to him (100 = career/project critical, 0 = noise)
Your own prioritising rubric from last round:
* Items from recruiters and job-boards should be prioritized based on their importance, with a minimum urgency of 50.
* Items from collaborators and service providers should be prioritized based on their urgency, with a minimum importance of 30.
Also write a summary badge of at most 6 words that would help him prioritise it at a glance.
Items (id | sender | subject | snippet):
r003-llama323b-06 | Service · DevSupport | Server Maintenance | Our servers will be down for maintenance.
p012 | Accounts · Stellan Print AB | Invoice 3391 – payment overdue | We have not received payment for invoice 3391. Please confirm the order number you used.
p039 | Collaborator · ex-colleague | Coffee next week? | I'm in town Tue–Thu. Any morning works for me, you pick.
p013 | Code host notifications | [games] New issue: runner lags on old Android | Frame drops after 20 s on a 2019 phone. Which browser version do you support?
p026 | Collaborator · bot tester | Found a bug in the tone pit | Undo after 'neither' skips a pair. Repro steps below. Want me to file it?
urgency and importance must be whole numbers 0-100. Example of the format for one item: {"id":"x01","urgency":30,"importance":70,"summary":"Interview prep notes, this week"}
Return JSON only: {"items":[ one object per item above, 5 objects, same ids ]}
